explanation: Bounded source-review approval of the two ownership repairs: seedReloadTransactions clones per-participant ownership for independent outer scopes, recordReloadTransaction retains unchanged participants, and the RADIUS acceptance/rollback callbacks remember and consume acceptance of restored prior state without retiring the tentative replacement. I found no completion deadlock in the traced path: finish releases its mutex before dispatch and never acquires the transaction lock; engine dispatch releases subscription locks before callbacks, and the gated unrelated participant runs after RADIUS through sorted coarse section nodes; both new regressions use actual Server.ReloadConfig and acceptance APIs with UDP accounting rather than fabricated acceptance events. gopls resolved production DeferReloadAcceptance and ReloadConfig callers, although it emitted shutdown warnings and omitted the build-tagged test references, which I inspected directly; no tests or runtime validation were run, so RED/GREEN discrimination, candidate-publication failure execution, daemon/PPP/kernel behavior, and interim cadence remain unproved here.
